{{Top|leg}}
An '''authority stick''' was a short wooden staff used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] carried an authority stick with a stone club head attached to it, which he wielded as an [[Axe/Legends|axe]].
